spec_case: issue #442's first item, closed by #537: a tree dynamic's combined failure text names each branch's own exception class
description: `tree-failure-class-names`'s companion case (one document would otherwise get unwieldy): a `flow: tree` dynamic (`max_concurrency: 1`, `on_error: continue`) with three branches needing the `scripted` adapter -- an `if` branch (RuntimeError, `core/conditional.py`'s own per-step wrap), a `reflector` branch whose generated child fails (RuntimeError, `generated_exec_failed: ...`), and a decomposing `prompt` branch whose planner call fails (DecompositionError). `fan.meta.error` names every branch's own displayed class the same way `tree-failure-class-names` does.
